# Getting help

Pick the fastest path for what you need:

| You need... | Go to |
|-------------|-------|
| A quick answer | The [FAQ](../docs/FAQ.md), most questions are already there |
| To ask something or share an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/NotebookLab/discussions) |
| To report something broken | A [bug report](https://github.com/Amey-Thakur/NotebookLab/issues/new/choose) with reproduction steps |
| To report a security problem | The [security policy](SECURITY.md), privately, never a public issue |
| To contribute a fix or feature | The [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) |

Issues are for confirmed bugs and scoped feature requests; conversations
start in Discussions. That keeps the tracker actionable and your question
visible to people who can answer it.
